canon_ref.note: Skinned on the page: Gregor, Cervial, Menes, Sostrom, Gerial. Calruz and Ceria are last seen overrun and Olesm is not seen again; the text never shows them die, so they are missing (user choice, 2026-09-24). Yvlon leads the few who escape.

b1.skinner_wakes_in_the_ruins.summary: In a vast hall of tombs Ceria reads a rhyme warning of Skinner. Then the sealed vault opens from inside: a legless giant of stolen skin, wearing the dead captains' faces, whose red eyes freeze the living with fear. It skins Sostrom and Gerial; Calruz loses an arm and Ceria is left behind.

system.name: Broken wand
system.note: She snaps her wand to loose a giant spike of ice that opens the way for Yvlon; the cold blackens her hand.
